messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Launch html file from tabset
parts:
Hi,

I created an interactive ggchoropleth using library animation.

I saved the result as local html page using saveHTML and everything works fine when I open html page inside application folder.

Now I want to open this local html page when I press one of tabsets, because this ggchoropleth is only one part of application.

How can make this possible?

Regards

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Launch html file from tabset
parts:
Maybe as an iframe?

tabPanel("Choropleth",
  tags$iframe(src="ggchoropleth.html", width=500, height=500)
)

and put the ggchoropleth.html file in a "www" subdirectory of your app.

messages.subject: Re: Launch html file from tabset
parts:
Example is taken from:

http://patilv.com/Animated-choropleths-using-animation-ggplot2-rCharts-googleVis-and-Shiny/

I am refering to the part:

*********************************************
library(animation) 
saveHTML({ for (i in 1:5) { uslessdc$CrimeRate=decadespct[,i][ match(uslessdc$STATE_NAME,decadespct$State)]# bring value of decade to map data mycols=c("#4daf4a","#fc8d62","red") # Setting a color palette ggchoropleth= ggplot(data = uslessdc, aes(x=x_proj, y=y_proj, group = DRAWSEQ, fill=CrimeRate)) + geom_polygon(color = "black")+ ggtitle(paste("Violent Crime Rate in", names(decadespct[i]))) + xlab("")+ ylab("")+scale_fill_manual(values=mycols, labels=c("Low", "Medium", "High"))+ theme(legend.position="top") print(ggchoropleth) } }, img.name = "decadeplots", imgdir = "decadeplots", htmlfile = "decadeplots.html", outdir = getwd(),autobrowse = FALSE,ani.height=400,ani.width=600, verbose=FALSE,autoplay=TRUE,title = "Violent Crime Rates")

******************************

My application is organized as in example:

https://github.com/jcheng5/shiny-partials

so I have:

ui <- shinyUI(navbarPage("My Application",
  tabPanel("Component 1", uiOutput("component1")),
  tabPanel("Component 2"),
  tabPanel("Component 3")
))

Regards
